measurement_space: Body current shape-key mix, pre-armature rest-state world meters; no evaluated posed mesh used for anthropometric values.

scene_settings.rest_pose: MPFB native A-pose; measure before local articulation; +Y forward, +X anatomical right

R.palm_span_definition: Joint-center distance finger2-1 head to finger5-1 head, excludes soft-surface margins and thumb.
R.foot_selection_definition: Skin vertices with foot or toe weights >0.01, below ankle center plus15mm; length along horizontal ankle-to-toe2 tip direction.

palm_skin_midsection.definition: Skin edge intersection with plane60% from wrist joint to middle MCP; thumb-heavy edges excluded; width perpendicular to palm long axis toward index-pinky MCP span. Diagnostic measure, not clinical anthropometry.

L.palm_span_definition: Joint-center distance finger2-1 head to finger5-1 head, excludes soft-surface margins and thumb.
L.foot_selection_definition: Skin vertices with foot or toe weights >0.01, below ankle center plus15mm; length along horizontal ankle-to-toe2 tip direction.

palm_skin_midsection.definition: Skin edge intersection with plane60% from wrist joint to middle MCP; thumb-heavy edges excluded; width perpendicular to palm long axis toward index-pinky MCP span. Diagnostic measure, not clinical anthropometry.

ribcage_section.height_choice: Fixed diagnostic plane at 0.7 times chosen source height; not a recovered 2D reference measurement.

waist_section.height_choice: Fixed diagnostic plane at 0.61 times chosen source height; not a recovered 2D reference measurement.

pelvis_section.height_choice: Fixed diagnostic plane at 0.54 times chosen source height; not a recovered 2D reference measurement.

measurements.assembled_context_note: Undivided cage coordinate bounds for retained contextual head + body feet; excludes hair, armor, soles and subdivision. This is distinct from full MPFB source height.

distal_finger_leakage_screen.definition: Nearest second/third finger bone segment, interior10%-90%, distance<14mm; foreign-digit weight>0.1 is a heuristic flag, not proof of a defect.
